ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85:15 ratio of low-intensity (black/dark grey) to high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant dark intensity across central and inner lobe regions; high-contrast light intensity mottling localized along the trailing edges of both lobes and extending from the median notch toward the center.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped depression with a calculated obtuse angle of approximately 140 degrees and minimal bounding-box depth relative to lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern with pixel-amplitudes ranging from 5 to 15 pixels; serrations are most pronounced and jagged on the distal portion of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature fitted to the outer boundaries of both lobes, with a more pronounced tapering and upward sweep on the left lobe compared to the broader right lobe.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-intensity circular pixel groups detected on the distal tip of the right lobe and intermittently along the leading edges of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) detected primarily on the right lobe, oriented vertically and diagonally against the base pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent parallel vertical rake marks on the mid-to-outer right lobe; white rosette scarring clusters concentrated on the right fluke tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly irregular, 'torn' appearance of the trailing edge serrations on the distal end of the right lobe.
